name: Class Features (Sable Knight)
text_md:
All of the following are class features of the sable knight prestige class.

A sable knight gains no proficiency with any weapon or armor beyond what she already possesses. At 3rd level, and every three levels thereafter, a sable knight may perform the Rite of the Black Oath, gaining a +1 profane bonus on Intimidate checks that stacks with itself.
